item.description:
### Installing - The installer window shows where to drag Unicorder, with an arrow to Applications. - Opened straight from the installer, Unicorder asks to be dragged to Applications first. - Once installed, Unicorder offers to eject the installer and move it to the Bin.
### Transcription - When a transcription has to download its model first, the meeting page shows how far the download has got, with the time left. - Cancelling a transcription stops at once, even while a model downloads in Settings. - Model downloads in Settings keep showing their progress when you come back to them, and can be cancelled. - The live transcript starts as soon as its model finishes downloading, during the recording.
### Summaries - Summaries with Apple Intelligence work on macOS 27: long meetings are split up again, and ordinary meetings are refused far less often.
### Look and feel - During the trial, Pro features are marked "Pro trial", with the days left in the tooltip. - Tidier spacing in the toolbar, around Settings in the sidebar and in the window for choosing a storage folder.
